
'''Ōji Shrine''' (王子神社, Ōji Jinja) is a Shinto shrine.

* Ōji Shrine (Ōji Gongen) – Located in Kita City, Tokyo. Former Gō-sha{{efn|District Shrines|WD=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qid=Q134917316|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}, Tokyo Ten Shrines, and part of the Tokyo Ten Shrines. Associated with Nyakuichi Ōji.
* Ōji Shrine – Located in Midori Ward, Yokohama.
* Ōji Shrine (Atsugi) – Located in Atsugi, Kanagawa (Ōji, Atsugi).
* Ōji Shrine – Located in Yamazaki. Associated with Nyakuichi Ōji.
* Ōji Shrine (Kurama, Kakegawa) – Located in Kurami.
* Ōji Shrine (Kamiuchida, Kakegawa) – Located in Kamiuchida, Kakegawa.
* Ōji Shrine (Kameoka) (Ōji Gongen) – Located in Kameoka City, Shino Town, Kameoka. Associated with Nyakuichi Ōji.
* Ōji Shrine (Nada, Kobe) – Located in Nada Ward, Kobe.
* Ōji Shrine (Kasai, Hyōgo) – Located in Kasai City.
* Ōji Shrine (Takamatsu) – Located in Takamatsu City.
* Ōji Shrine (Tokushima City) – Located in Tokushima City.
* Ōji Shrine (Ishii, Tokushima) – Located in Ishii Town, Myōdō District.
* Ōji Shrine (Seiyo, Ehime) – Located in Seiyo City.
* Ōji Shrine (Saiki, Oita) – Located in Saiki City.

== Oji Shrine (皇子神社) ==

* Ōji Shrine (Anan) - A shrine located in Anan City, Tokushima Prefecture.
* Ōji Shrine (Takamatsu City) - A shrine located in Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture.
* Ōji Shrine (Marugame City) - A shrine located in Marugame City, Kagawa Prefecture.
* Ōji Shrine (Shōdoshima Town) - A shrine located in Shōdoshima Town, Shōzu District, Kagawa Prefecture.
